name: ecp_inspect
description: Show a symbol's full context: signature, body, edges, callers, overrides, 1-hop impact

file_path.description: Substring filter applied to the target file path of incoming/outgoing edges. Case-sensitive substring match (not glob)

include_tests.description: Include edges whose target lives in a test file. Defaults to false

kind.description: Comma-separated list of node kinds (lowercase, e.g. `function,method`) to keep on the *target* side of incoming/outgoing edges

name_flag.description: Named alias for the positional NAME argument — kept for parity with old MCP / wrapper habits

relation_types.description: Comma-separated list of relation types (lowercase, e.g. `calls,imports`)

name: ecp_find
description: Locate symbols by exact name (default), substring (`--mode fuzzy`), or BM25 ranking (`--mode bm25`)

all.description: Return all matches instead of the single top-ranked one. Affects `exact` and `fuzzy` modes; `bm25` always returns top-K buckets

batch.description: Read patterns from stdin (`bm25` mode only — one per line, lines starting with `#` or empty are skipped). Engines are loaded once outside the per-query loop so mmap setup + rkyv access are amortised across queries. Each query is emitted as a separate block prefixed by `=== pattern: <pattern> ===`

file.description: Disambiguate when name has multiple matches: substring on file path. Same matching rule as `ecp impact --file`

fuzzy.description: Shorthand for `--mode fuzzy`. Ignored when `--mode` is supplied explicitly with a non-default value

include_tests.description: Include hits from test files in `fuzzy` mode (skipped by default). `exact` mode automatically searches tests without needing this flag. `bm25` mode bucketises into a separate `tests` array and is unaffected by this flag

pattern.description: Pattern: symbol name (or name fragment in `fuzzy` / `bm25` mode). Required unless `--batch` is set (`bm25` mode only — patterns then come from stdin)

repo.description: Repository selector (path | name | @all | csv mix). Defaults to cwd. `@<group>` is rejected at the top level — use `ecp group find` instead

name: ecp_impact
description: Symbol blast radius — affected callers (counts + call sites)

baseline.description: Git ref — compute blast radius across all symbols changed between this baseline and HEAD. Mutually exclusive with positional <name>

batch.description: Read target symbol names from stdin (one per line; `#` and blank lines skipped). The graph is loaded once and N symbols are resolved sequentially — amortises mmap + process spawn across queries. Each result is prefixed by `=== target: <name> ===` so callers can split the stream unambiguously. Flags like --direction / --depth / --include-tests apply uniformly to all targets

confidence_threshold.description: Informational confidence gate — promotes heuristic edges when T4-7/T5-33 emit per-edge tiers. Currently controls the --explain-confidence report

explain_confidence.description: Emit explain_confidence block with threshold + per-tier filtered counts

file.description: Disambiguate when name has multiple matches: substring on file path. `--file_path` / `--file-path` stay as aliases for back-compat

format.description: Output format (mostly internal — agent doesn't set this)

high_trust_only.description: Default OFF — recall-first: traverse every edge regardless of confidence (cross-crate refs at 0.7 are still real callers, just less certain). Pass `--high-trust-only=true` to restrict to confidence ≥ 0.8 edges for a noise-light view; when filtering kicks in, the output reports `hidden_edges` so missed coverage stays visible

kind.description: Disambiguate by kind (function | method | class | route | ...)

literal.description: List sites of a path-shaped string literal by exact value. Mutually exclusive with --target/--baseline/<name>. Returns JSON with each site's file, line, enclosing fn, and sink classification (`sink:read` / `sink:write` / `sink:open-read` / `sink:join` / etc). Designed for LLM split-brain queries: `ecp impact --literal session_meta.json` answers "where is this file read or written?" without writing cypher

literal_coherence.description: Auto-detect likely path-literal split-brain pairs across all PathLiteral nodes. Conservative: same extension, similar basename, nearby directories, and read-only vs write-only sink separation

min_confidence.description: Override the high-trust threshold with a custom value (0.0–1.0). If set, takes precedence over --high-trust-only

name.description: Target symbol name (mutually exclusive with --baseline). Equivalent to the `--target` named form below. Optional when `--batch` is set or when a non-positional mode flag (`--target`, `--baseline`, `--literal`, `--literal-coherence`) supplies the query

no_heuristic.description: Suppress heuristic callers (MirrorsField, EventTopicMirror) from the blast radius. Default: heuristic callers ARE shown, in a separate `heuristic_callers` bucket tagged `requires_verification`. Pass this flag for a pure-deterministic blast radius

relation_types.description: Comma-separated relation types to follow (calls, extends, ...)

target.description: Named alias for the positional NAME argument — kept for parity with old MCP / wrapper habits

test_coverage.description: Coverage gap analysis: for each touched symbol, classify by test-caller presence (uncovered / partial / covered). Uses FunctionMeta.is_test flag from per-language extraction. Outputs uncovered symbols first to support LLM PR review ("X 改了沒測試"). Implies --include-tests during traversal so test callers are reachable from the walker

name: ecp_rename
description: AST-aware multi-file rename

dry_run.description: Plan + verify only — do not mutate any file. Prints the diff summary to stdout

markdown.description: Also rename word-boundary occurrences in .md / .markdown / .rst / .txt documentation files. Default OFF

new_name.description: The new name to apply (equivalent to `--new-name` flag)

new_name_flag.description: Named alias for the positional NEW_NAME argument

repo.description: Repository root. Defaults to current dir

show_heuristic_mirrors.description: Expand the heuristic mirror list in the output. When unset, only the count is shown. Tier shows the `unresolved` sentinel until T4-7 populates real tier/check values

symbol.description: The symbol name to rename (equivalent to `--symbol` flag)

symbol_flag.description: Named alias for the positional SYMBOL argument

name: ecp_pattern
description: Syntax-pattern search over source files — the statement shapes the graph does not hold. `--callers-of` scopes the scan to one symbol's callers

callers_of.description: Restrict the scan to files that call this symbol. Accepts the same `Owner.method` qualification as `ecp rename`

lang.description: Restrict the scan to one file extension, without the dot (`py`, `ts`). A pattern that fails to compile for it is then an error

limit.description: Cap on reported matches. 0 means no cap

pattern.description: ast-grep pattern, e.g. `requests.get($URL)`. `$NAME` captures one node, `$$$NAME` captures a run of them

name: ecp_cypher
description: Cypher query escape hatch

format.description: Output format. Omit for the LLM-tuned default; explicit `--format toon|json|text` for the neutral / round-trippable / human paths

query.description: Named alias for the positional QUERY argument

query_positional.description: The Cypher query string. Supports a read-only subset of openCypher:

repo.description: Repository to query. Cypher operates on a single graph (single-repo only). If --repo resolves to multiple repos, an error is returned

name: ecp_summary
description: Registry + repo health. Default: scoped to the cwd repo when indexed; registry overview otherwise. Use `--repo @all` for the registry overview explicitly

detailed.description: Verbose per-section breakdown (include branch rows, etc.)

format.description: Output format. Omit for the LLM-tuned default (toon-encoded, lossy confidence rounding + compact timestamps). `--format toon` is the neutral toon encoding of the full payload; `--format json` is the full-fidelity JSON; `--format text` is the human-friendly fallback

repo.description: Repository selector (path | name | @all | csv mix). If omitted and cwd is an indexed repo: scoped per-repo health. If omitted and cwd is not indexed: registry overview. Use `--repo @all` to force the registry overview regardless of cwd

name: ecp_routes
description: List HTTP routes; with path, show handler + caller chain

depth.description: Max depth for upstream caller traversal (only applies when <path> is set)

include_tests.description: Include routes declared inside test files (`tests/`, `test/`, `*_test.*`, `*.spec.*`, etc.). Default: off — most agent queries want production routes, not test fixtures. When set, the output gains a `test_results` array listing the test-only routes alongside the regular `results`. Test classification reuses `File.category = FileCategory::Test` set at index time (`ecp-analyzer/src/resolution/builder.rs:32`)

method.description: Filter by HTTP method (GET / POST / PATCH / DELETE / ...)

path.description: If given, show handler + caller chain for this route path. If omitted, list all routes

name: ecp_contracts
description: Cross-repo API contracts inventory (routes / queue / RPC)

kind.description: Contract kind to scan: routes / queue / rpc / all

repo.description: Repository selector (path | name | @group | @all | csv). Requires ≥2 repos to be meaningful

unmatched_only.description: Only show contracts without a paired consumer/producer

name: ecp_diff
description: Edge-level resolver delta — binding tier-degradation (silent break), route / contract changes

baseline.description: Git ref to compare against: branch / tag / commit SHA / HEAD~N / PR/<n>. Required unless `--baseline-graph` is supplied (A-mode snapshot diff)

baseline_graph.description: A-mode: path to baseline `graph.bin` (skip git checkout + re-index). When set, requires `--current-graph` and restricts sections to those that read directly from graph.bin (routes / contracts / symbols)

current_graph.description: A-mode: path to current `graph.bin`. Required when `--baseline-graph` is supplied

format.description: Output format. Omit for the LLM-tuned default; pass `--format text|json|toon` for the alternative renderings

repo.description: Repository root path (defaults to current directory)

section.description: Comma-separated section(s) to diff: bindings, routes, contracts, symbols, or all

verbose.description: List every change (text format only). Default truncates to top-10 per section

name: ecp_uninstall
description: Remove all ecp host integrations and optionally wipe the index cache

agent.description: Only uninstall integration for one coding agent (claude, codex, gemini). Omit to uninstall all detected agents (and remove the binary itself)

dry_run.description: List what would be removed without actually deleting anything

name: ecp_shape-check
description: Detect drift between HTTP consumer access patterns and Route response shapes

repo.description: Repository root path (defaults to current directory)

route.description: Filter: only report drift for routes whose path matches this substring. When None (default), all routes with extracted shape are checked

name: ecp_tool-map
description: Enumerate calls to external HTTP/DB/Redis/queue clients via per-file import-binding analysis

category.description: Filter to a specific category. Comma-separated: `http`, `db`, `redis`, `queue`. Empty = all

name: ecp_review
description: LLM-workflow audit aggregator over changed files, high-confidence signals only

repo.description: Repository root path (defaults to current directory)

since.description: Git ref to diff against. Defaults to working-tree changes (HEAD)

verdicts.description: Emit provable verdicts derived from `ecp diff --section all` instead of the per-file aggregate findings. Requires `--since <ref>` (the baseline). Output shape: `{baseline, current, verdicts, elapsed_ms}`

name: ecp_heuristics
description: Heuristic detectors: `saga` (Saga/Outbox), `schema-bindings` (MirrorsField), `event-mirrors` (EventTopicMirror)

name: ecp_path
description: Shortest route between two symbols: the ordered chain plus the edge that makes each hop

direction.description: Which way to walk from `from`. `down` follows callees (A calls … calls B), `up` follows callers, `both` ignores edge direction

from_file.description: Disambiguate `<FROM>` when the name has several definitions: substring on the file path

include_heuristic.description: Allow heuristic edges (MirrorsField, EventTopicMirror) as steps. Each one is tagged `requiresVerification` in the output

include_tests.description: Include test files in the route. Off by default, so a production path is not routed through a test helper that happens to call both ends

min_confidence.description: Drop edges below this confidence (0.0–1.0). Default 0.0 is recall-first, matching `ecp impact`

relation_types.description: Comma-separated relation types to follow (calls, extends, ...). Default: every non-containment relation

name: ecp_processes
description: List detected Process (execution-flow) nodes, or `processes trace <pattern>` for step sequence

all.description: Return all processes, disabling the default min-signal filter. Without this flag, short intra-community chains (step_count < 7) are suppressed because they carry near-zero architectural signal

community.description: Filter the list view to a single community ID

name: ecp_usage
description: Usage dashboard over CLI + MCP telemetry — counts, p50/p99 latency, error rate

all.description: Show the full per-subcommand table (no truncation)

clear.description: Delete the telemetry logs — both `cli-calls.jsonl` and MCP `calls.jsonl`, since a dashboard that still counts half its history is not cleared. Honors -p to scope to the current repo; otherwise clears every repo

failures.description: Show recent failing commands with messages instead of the dashboard

no_color.description: Force color off (also honored: NO_COLOR env, non-TTY stdout)

project.description: Scope to the current repository only (default: all repos)

source.description: Filter which telemetry files feed the dashboard: cli, mcp, or all (default)

name: ecp_peers
description: [multi-agent peer-sync only — single-session has no peers] Inspect / talk to other ecp watch sessions on this repo. Pick `subcmd`; see each arg's [tag] for which subcmd uses it.

clear.description: [inbox] Discard everything in the inbox, including entries the 4KB hook payload never showed. Nothing is discarded automatically, so this is the only way to drop queued content.

depth.description: [plan] Max impact traversal depth per target (default 5).

direction.description: [log] Filter: 'in' or 'out'. [plan] Impact direction: upstream|downstream|both (default both).

format.description: [status] Output format. `json` returns an array with session_id, agent_name, pid, last_touched, base_sha, watcher (alive|dead|not-started), watcher_pid. [plan] also honored.

include_tests.description: [plan] Count test-only symbols as collisions (default false).

msg_id.description: [thread] msg_id returned by say or seen in log.

name.description: [name] Agent name to assign to this session (shown in status / payloads, targetable by say).

pairs.description: [status] Lead overview: which alive sessions share a dirty FILE (HARD), pairwise, instead of the per-session list.

peer.description: [diff] Peer session ID or agent name (from subcmd=status). [log] Filter messages to/from this peer.

reply.description: [say] msg_id this message is replying to.

repo.description: Path to the repo root (optional; defaults to cwd).

since.description: [log] RFC3339 timestamp — only show messages after this.

subcmd.description: Which peer operation to run. Each subcmd uses a disjoint subset of the args below.

symbol.description: [diff] If set, only show dirty entries touching this symbol name.

targets.description: [plan] Comma-separated symbols a lead intends to split across agents; reports blast-radius overlaps + disjoint work packages.

to.description: [say] Target peer session ID or agent name. Omit to broadcast.

name: ecp_group
description: Multi-repo group operations: extract contracts, query cross-repo impact, find / batch-find across all members. Pick `subcmd`; see each arg's [tag] for which subcmd uses it. Groups are managed via `ecp admin group add/remove`.

allow_stale.description: [sync] Don't bail when per-repo index is stale.

batch.description: [find] Read patterns from stdin (one per line, `#` for comments). The active `merge` mode is re-applied per pattern.

cross_depth.description: [impact] Cross-repo hop depth (clamped to 1 in first wave).

direction.description: [impact] Traversal direction (callers vs callees). Default upstream.

exact_only.description: [sync] Skip BM25 stage; exact match only.

include_tests.description: [impact] Include test files in local traversal.

merge.description: [find] Result assembly: `none` = per-repo bucketed concat (default); `rrf` = Reciprocal Rank Fusion → unified top-K.

name.description: [all] Group name (must exist in registry; add members via `ecp admin group add <repo> <group>`).

pattern.description: [find] BM25 symbol pattern (name or fragment). Required unless `batch` is true.

repo.description: [impact] Member name within the group (dir_name or alias). [contracts] Filter by repo name.

subcmd.description: Which group operation to run. Each subcmd uses a disjoint subset of the args below.

target.description: [impact] Symbol name (function / method / file) to analyse.

name: ecp_schema
description: Read-only schema inventory: per-language BlindSpot emitter coverage (`blindspots`), every RelType edge label with LLM-utility tier (`reltypes`), every NodeKind variant with the distinction that keeps it from being folded into a sibling (`node-kinds`), and the rkyv graph.bin format version + bump history (`graph-version`). Pick `subcmd`.

format.description: [all] Output format. `json` (default) is structured; `text` is a human-readable table.

subcmd.description: Which schema inventory to emit. All four are graph-free (no .ecp/ load required).
